items.note: Loop 4 on the bytes after commit d3715dcd. A word-level diff 2f281e85..d3715dcd of this page and its artifact.md is identical on all eight module pages and changes only: the two Where-to-look location phrases (activity 1 and the final apply activity) and their recap and Markdown copies; one print rule for the recap section; one Restart line that clears page completion; the fragment handler and its navigation guard; and an Escape guard for the lesson editor. No teaching, task, check, checker, starter or no-JS text changed otherwise. On this page the activity-4 (Raise your own exceptions) inventory.py lesson editor (fieldset #exed), its starter, EDITOR_CFG, adapter, checker rules, TOPIC.need/obj maps and every activity-4 task, step and teaching string are byte-unchanged from the bytes loop 3 ruled on, so this ruling rests on that byte-identity plus the probes below; this loop did not re-read the checker rules. Completing activity 4 still requires the learner to author the raising, handling (handler, else and finally) and module-logger code that objectives o1-o3 name in the editor (construction rather than recognition, as the recommendation asked); the editor check is the only check for that step and page completion requires every activity passed. Re-verified on the current bytes in JS-enabled Chromium: a fresh load with an #activity-4 fragment is normalised to #activity-1; clicking the locked activity-4 timeline link and setting a manual #activity-5 hash leave the learner on activity 1 with Continue hidden; running the untouched starter, and then an emptied file, in the still-locked activity-4 editor (the editor output region changed after each run, so both runs fired) leaves data-pep-completed=false on the fieldset and the section with credit 0 and no page completion. The new Escape guard targets only the editor: a synthetic Escape keydown inside the editor left Objectives open, and Escape elsewhere still closed Objectives and returned focus to its summary. A passing completion was not exercised and no protected input was written or entered. The loop-3 residual about literal step wording is unchanged and remains non-blocking.
